summary: Completed comprehensive testing of P1 features for Tubiate: Password Reset Flow, Pagination, and Result Caching. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend tests verified forgot-password page renders correctly with 3-step flow, login page has 'Forgot password?' link, signup redirects to /pricing, unpaid users redirected from /dashboard to /pricing.

minor.issue: When SMTP email fails, returns 500 but code is still stored in DB. Functionally works but could show misleading error to user.

passed_tests: POST /api/auth/request-password-reset - returns success for non-existent email (no info leak)
POST /api/auth/request-password-reset - stores code in DB
POST /api/auth/reset-password - returns 400 for invalid code
POST /api/auth/reset-password - returns 400 for password under 6 chars
POST /api/auth/reset-password - returns 400 for empty token
POST /api/auth/reset-password - has correct error response structure
POST /api/auth/login - works with previously reset password (adrian@test1.com)
POST /api/channels/enrich - response includes 'cached' field
POST /api/channels/enrich - has correct response structure (channels, total, cached)
POST /api/channels/enrich - requires authentication (401/403 without token)
/forgot-password page renders with email input (data-testid='reset-email')
/forgot-password page has 'Back to Login' link that works
/forgot-password - submitting email advances to code entry step (step 2)
/forgot-password - step 2 has reset code, new password, confirm password inputs
Login page has 'Forgot password?' link (data-testid='forgot-password-link')
Clicking 'Forgot password?' navigates to /forgot-password
Dashboard pagination controls exist with data-testid: pagination-controls, page-first, page-prev, page-next, page-last
Pagination shows only when totalPages > 1 (correct behavior)
New signup redirects to /pricing (not /dashboard)
Unpaid users redirected from /dashboard to /pricing
All pages load: Landing, Login, Signup, Pricing, Terms, Privacy, Forgot Password
Admin user (admin@tubiate.com) can access dashboard
critical_code_review_comments: Password reset SMTP error handling could be improved - currently returns 500 when email fails but code is already stored in DB. User may retry and create multiple unused codes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 Features tested and working: (1) Password Reset Flow - /api/auth/request-password-reset sends 6-digit code via email (SMTP may fail in test env but code stored in DB), /api/auth/reset-password validates code and updates password. Frontend has 3-step forgot password flow at /forgot-password. (2) Pagination - Dashboard has pagination controls (first/prev/next/last with data-testid) that appear when >25 channels in results. (3) Result Caching - /api/channels/enrich returns 'cached' field showing number of channels served from 24-hour cache. All existing pages still work. Note: SMTP may return 500 when sending to some test mailboxes but code is still stored.
